```sh
kafka cluster log-dirs
```

Describe log directories and their partition sizes, per broker

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Queries the requested broker ids; result sizes and partitions are cluster-specific.

## Flags

| Flag                             | Description                                        |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`             | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092   |
| `--broker <number> (repeatable)` | limit to this broker id (repeatable; default: all) |
| `--topic <string> (repeatable)`  | limit to this topic (repeatable; default: all)     |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster log-dirs --brokers localhost:9092
kafka cluster log-dirs --topic orders --broker 1 --broker 2
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "brokers": []
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
